native-access.root_cause: Prior WinError 5 ancestor query-handle failure before native execution; predecessor assertions wrap the same prerequisite.
native-access.environment: Supported current-user Windows native access and security/authority prerequisites.

journal-checkout-bytes.environment: Exact SQL bytes, checkout conversion and supported storage setup.
journal-checkout-bytes.phase1: NOT RUN; production/resource changes require separate approval

hostile-fixture.root_cause: Missing fixed external hostile fixture and authenticated owned-fixture prerequisites.
hostile-fixture.environment: Separately authorized hostile fixture, aliases, security profile and volume evidence.
hostile-fixture.phase1: NOT RUN; do not fabricate or provision

retired-import.root_cause: Experiment imports retired engineering_orchestration namespace during discovery.
retired-import.environment: Historical experiment/cutover disposition; not a missing package to install.

containment-launch.root_cause: Prior broad launch omitted -I; containment guard required -I -B and exercised zero cases.
containment-launch.environment: Locked interpreter, isolation, native/privileged hostile prerequisites.

migration-expectation.root_cause: Prior assertions expect schema/migrations v3 while approved implementation includes migration4/execution entry; includes historical O55 wrapper.
migration-expectation.environment: SQLite schema and compatibility fixtures; some wrappers include native prerequisites.

package-expectation.root_cause: Prior package lists omit approved Journal resources; other latent resource/schema expectations and C111 external wheel/setup prerequisites remain.
package-expectation.environment: Static metadata for one test; C111 additionally needs owned setup and authenticated external package evidence.
package-expectation.risk: low for static metadata; higher for C111 fixture/package boundary

cli-help-expectation.root_cause: Root-help literal predates approved alpha command; approved parser/documentation include alpha.
cli-help-expectation.environment: CPython3.12, installed existing project dependencies, benign synthetic temp project only.
cli-help-expectation.phase1: SELECTED for exact before/after help-only reproduction

namespace-manifest.root_cause: Prior explicit living-file namespace guard reports nine legacy occurrences in existing schemas/tests.
namespace-manifest.environment: Exact living-file inventory, historical allowances and identity contracts.
namespace-manifest.risk: medium; do not broaden namespace allowances to silence findings
